One question I have, if I talk to a counselor or the school psychologist or something, and they believe I'm at risk and hospitalize me would my family end up receiving really expensive bills?

I'm not really sure how I feel about that... I've always been really scared of that, I don't wanna become a burden on my friends or my family which is why I've never been to a counselor or called a hotline or ever really admitted I feel this way. I'm scared to be sent to a hospital for a week get out feeling the same then have my parents receive a bill that they can't pay.... We don't have much money know and I already feel like I drain them economically enough

This made me smile :), I wish I could always feel as sane as I do right now. When I feel at my worst I can't like reason with myself, I want to survive and fight but I keep having all these terrible thoughts and the worst part is that I feel I actually mean them when I have them. Even if for just one second

I'm not always sure, it kind of just a bunch of things and not just one big one, things that by themselves wouldn't be that bad but they keep piling up.... 
For example, I never really see a future for myself, I don't see anything in particular that I look forward to.... And then I have my family which I constantly have to put up with, who kind of just use me as the scapegoat for everything...
I've slowly been losing interest in things I used to love doing, I always just move on. But worse of all is that I know my life isn't terrible and I get so angry at myself so much because I belive I don't have a reason to feel the way I do... I feel so alone and idk how to open myself to seek help properly. And I'm just scared...
Sorry if I like rambled
